purpose: Identify the guidance, conditions, or authority under which something occurs.
keywords: N + の下で / の下に
We conducted the experiment under our teacher’s guidance.
We compared the two methods under identical conditions.
formation: N + の下で / の下に
restrictions: 下 is read もと; often refers to supervision or shared conditions.
mistake: Use 下（した） for an ordinary physical location below something.
